CHATBOT_API_KEY <- "AIzaSyD8py7k79KsTHWxM6aYY6A7OMzB0NknHuo"
 
generateContent <- function(prompt, api_key,
 model_endpoint = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent") {
 headers <- c(`Content-Type` = "application/json")
 payload  <- list(contents = list(list(parts = list(list(text = as.character(prompt))))))
 body_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE)
 res <- tryCatch(
   httr::POST(url = model_endpoint, httr::add_headers(.headers = headers),
              query = list(key = api_key), body = body_json, encode = "raw", timeout(30)),
   error = function(e) e)
 if (inherits(res, "error")) return(list(ok=FALSE, text=paste0("Network error: ", res$message)))
 status   <- httr::status_code(res)
 raw_text <- tryCatch(httr::content(res, as="text", encoding="UTF-8"), error=function(e) NA_character_)
 if (status == 200) {
   parsed <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(raw_text, simplifyVector=FALSE), error=function(e) NULL)
   gtxt   <- NULL
   if (!is.null(parsed) && !is.null(parsed$candidates) && length(parsed$candidates)>0)
     gtxt <- parsed$candidates[[1]]$content$parts[[1]]$text
   if (!is.null(gtxt)) return(list(ok=TRUE, status=status, text=as.character(gtxt)))
   return(list(ok=FALSE, status=status, text=paste0("No parsable response. Raw: ", raw_text)))
 }
 list(ok=FALSE, status=status, text=paste0("HTTP ", status, " - ", raw_text))
}
 
# ─── CLINICAL HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
calcBMI      <- function(w, h) round(w / (h/100)^2, 1)
bmiCategory  <- function(b) if(b<18.5)"UNDERWEIGHT" else if(b<25)"NORMAL" else if(b<30)"OVERWEIGHT" else if(b<35)"OBESE I" else "OBESE II+"
bmiColor     <- function(b) if(b<18.5)"var(--warn)" else if(b<25)"var(--success)" else if(b<30)"var(--warn)" else "var(--danger)"
 
predictHypertension <- function(d) {
 s <- sum(d$ap_hi>140, d$ap_lo>90, d$age>50, d$weight>80)
 ifelse(s>=2,"High","Low")
}
predictDiabetes <- function(d) {
 s <- sum(d$gluc>2, d$cholesterol>2, d$age>45, d$weight>75)
 ifelse(s>=2,"High","Low")
}
calcFramingham <- function(age, gender, chol, ap_hi, smoke) {
 base <- if (gender==2) {
   0.005*(age-45) + 0.08*(chol-1) + 0.003*(ap_hi-120) + if(smoke==1) 0.12 else 0
 } else {
   0.004*(age-45) + 0.06*(chol-1) + 0.0025*(ap_hi-120) + if(smoke==1) 0.09 else 0
 }
 pmin(pmax(base, 0.01), 0.99)
}
riskLabel <- function(p) if(p>0.65)"HIGH RISK" else if(p>0.4)"MODERATE RISK" else "LOW RISK"
riskColor <- function(p) if(p>0.65)"var(--danger)" else if(p>0.4)"var(--warn)" else "var(--success)"
riskClass <- function(p) if(p>0.65)"hi" else if(p>0.4)"mid" else "lo"
 
# AI content generators
genRecommendations <- function(rp, ak)
 generateContent(paste0(
   "You are a cardiologist. Provide 8 numbered, highly specific, actionable cardiovascular health ",
   "recommendations for a patient with this profile: ", rp,
   ". Each recommendation should include the medical rationale. Be warm, professional, and precise."), ak)
 
genMealPlan <- function(rp, ak)
 generateContent(paste0(
   "Create a detailed 7-day heart-healthy meal plan for: ", rp,
   ". Format:\nDAY 1:\n  Breakfast: ...\n  Lunch: ...\n  Dinner: ...\n  Snack: ...\n",
   "Include calorie estimates and specify heart-healthy ingredients."), ak)
 
genExercisePlan <- function(rp, age, ak)
 generateContent(paste0(
   "Create a safe 4-week progressive cardiovascular exercise plan for a ", age,
   "-year-old with risk profile: ", rp,
   ". Include: weekly schedule, exercise type, duration, heart rate zones, and safety warnings."), ak)
 
genStory <- function(lvl, factors, name, ak)
 generateContent(paste0(
   "Write an empathetic, motivational 300-word health narrative for ", name,
   " who has ", lvl, " cardiovascular risk. Key factors: ", paste(factors, collapse=", "),
   ". Opening scenario → what risk means for daily life → 3 specific lifestyle changes ",
   "with vivid description → inspiring call to action. Use second person (you/your). Warm, honest tone."), ak)
 
genMedInfo <- function(rp, ak)
 generateContent(paste0(
   "Based on this cardiovascular risk profile: ", rp,
   ", provide educational information (NOT prescriptions) about: ",
   "1) Classes of medications commonly prescribed for these conditions, ",
   "2) How they work, 3) Lifestyle alternatives. Emphasize consulting a doctor."), ak)
 
# ─── SVG GENERATORS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
makeGaugeSVG <- function(prob) {
 pct  <- round(prob * 100)
 col  <- if(prob>0.65)"#ff4d6d" else if(prob>0.4)"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0"
 ang  <- -90 + 180*prob
 dl   <- 283; off <- dl - dl*prob
 rl   <- riskLabel(prob)
 sprintf('
<svg viewBox="0 0 280 175" width="100%%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
 <defs>
   <linearGradient id="ggrad" x1="0%%" y1="0%%" x2="100%%" y2="0%%">
     <stop offset="0%%" stop-color="#06d6a0"/>
     <stop offset="48%%" stop-color="#ff9f1c"/>
     <stop offset="100%%" stop-color="#ff4d6d"/>
   </linearGradient>
   <filter id="gglow"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.5" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
   <radialGradient id="rg" cx="50%%" cy="80%%" r="60%%">
     <stop offset="0%%" stop-color="%s" stop-opacity="0.18"/>
     <stop offset="100%%" stop-color="%s" stop-opacity="0"/>
   </radialGradient>
 </defs>
 <ellipse cx="140" cy="145" rx="110" ry="50" fill="url(#rg)"/>
 <!-- Track -->
 <path d="M28,145 A112,112 0 0,1 252,145" fill="none" stroke="#1e2d3d" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round"/>
 <!-- Value arc -->
 <path d="M28,145 A112,112 0 0,1 252,145" fill="none" stroke="url(#ggrad)" stroke-width="20"
       stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="%s" stroke-dashoffset="%s" filter="url(#gglow)"/>
 <!-- Inner highlight -->
 <path d="M28,145 A112,112 0 0,1 252,145" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.06)" stroke-width="4"
       stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="%s" stroke-dashoffset="%s"/>
 <!-- Tick marks -->
 <g stroke="#2a3f52" stroke-width="2">
   <line x1="28" y1="145" x2="44" y2="145"/>
   <line x1="61" y1="45" x2="72" y2="58"/>
   <line x1="140" y1="33" x2="140" y2="48"/>
   <line x1="219" y1="45" x2="208" y2="58"/>
   <line x1="252" y1="145" x2="236" y2="145"/>
 </g>
 <!-- Tick labels -->
 <text x="20" y="165" fill="#3d5a6e" font-size="11" font-family="monospace">0</text>
 <text x="56" y="38" fill="#3d5a6e" font-size="11" font-family="monospace">25</text>
 <text x="128" y="26" fill="#3d5a6e" font-size="11" font-family="monospace">50</text>
 <text x="208" y="38" fill="#3d5a6e" font-size="11" font-family="monospace">75</text>
 <text x="248" y="165" fill="#3d5a6e" font-size="11" font-family="monospace">100</text>
 <!-- Needle -->
 <g transform="rotate(%s 140 145)">
   <line x1="140" y1="145" x2="140" y2="48" stroke="%s" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#gglow)"/>
   <line x1="140" y1="145" x2="140" y2="162" stroke="%s" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
 </g>
 <circle cx="140" cy="145" r="10" fill="#0b1724" stroke="%s" stroke-width="2.5"/>
 <circle cx="140" cy="145" r="4"  fill="%s"/>
 <!-- Score text -->
 <text x="140" y="128" text-anchor="middle" fill="%s" font-size="38" font-weight="700"
       font-family="monospace" filter="url(#gglow)">%s</text>
 <text x="140" y="143" text-anchor="middle" fill="#3d5a6e" font-size="10" font-family="monospace">RISK %%</text>
 <!-- Badge -->
 <rect x="95" y="154" width="90" height="20" rx="10" fill="%s1a" stroke="%s44" stroke-width="1"/>
 <text x="140" y="168" text-anchor="middle" fill="%s" font-size="10" font-weight="700"
       font-family="monospace">%s</text>
</svg>',
   col, col, dl, round(off,1), dl, round(off,1),
   round(ang,1), col, col, col, col,
   col, pct, col, col, col, rl)
}
 
makeBodyMapSVG <- function(prob, ht, db, smoke, active, bmi) {
 hc <- if(prob>0.6)"#ff4d6d" else if(prob>0.35)"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0"
 bc <- if(prob>0.55)"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0"
 kc <- if(db=="High")"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0"
 lc <- if(smoke==1)"#ff4d6d" else "#06d6a0"
 ac <- if(ht=="High")"#ff4d6d" else "#06d6a0"
 vc <- if(bmi>30)"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0"
 
 ring <- function(cx,cy,r,col) sprintf(
   '<circle cx="%s" cy="%s" r="%s" fill="%s06" stroke="%s" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.25"/>
    <circle cx="%s" cy="%s" r="%s" fill="%s12" stroke="%s" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.55"/>
    <circle cx="%s" cy="%s" r="%s" fill="%s28" stroke="%s" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="%s" cy="%s" r="%s" fill="%s"/>',
   cx,cy,r+12,col,col, cx,cy,r+6,col,col, cx,cy,r+2,col,col, cx,cy,r,col)
 
 sprintf('
<svg viewBox="0 0 250 310" width="100%%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
 <defs><filter id="bgl"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.5" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></defs>
 <!-- Silhouette -->
 <ellipse cx="125" cy="44" rx="29" ry="32" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1.5"/>
 <rect x="107" y="71" width="36" height="22" rx="8" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1"/>
 <path d="M72,93 Q56,99 52,140 L56,210 Q70,222 125,224 Q180,222 194,210 L198,140 Q194,99 178,93 Z" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1.5"/>
 <path d="M72,96 Q44,103 38,140 Q32,176 40,202 Q46,216 57,213 Q64,202 66,180 Q70,148 75,128 Z" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1"/>
 <path d="M178,96 Q206,103 212,140 Q218,176 210,202 Q204,216 193,213 Q186,202 184,180 Q180,148 175,128 Z" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1"/>
 <path d="M82,222 Q76,254 74,280 Q72,300 84,308 Q96,311 100,298 Q104,272 107,244 L112,222 Z" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1"/>
 <path d="M168,222 Q174,254 176,280 Q178,300 166,308 Q154,311 150,298 Q146,272 143,244 L138,222 Z" fill="#0f1e2d" stroke="#1e3347" stroke-width="1"/>
 <!-- Organs -->
 %s %s %s %s %s %s
 <!-- Labels -->
 <line x1="106" y1="113" x2="82" y2="104" stroke="%s" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3,2" opacity="0.6"/>
 <text x="79" y="101" fill="%s" font-size="8" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="end">HEART</text>
 <line x1="127" y1="50" x2="154" y2="40" stroke="%s" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3,2" opacity="0.6"/>
 <text x="156" y="38" fill="%s" font-size="8" font-family="monospace">BRAIN</text>
 <line x1="137" y1="150" x2="162" y2="142" stroke="%s" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3,2" opacity="0.6"/>
 <text x="164" y="140" fill="%s" font-size="8" font-family="monospace">KIDNEY</text>
 <line x1="113" y1="122" x2="82" y2="131" stroke="%s" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3,2" opacity="0.6"/>
 <text x="80" y="129" fill="%s" font-size="8" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="end">LUNGS</text>
 <line x1="120" y1="148" x2="82" y2="158" stroke="%s" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3,2" opacity="0.6"/>
 <text x="80" y="156" fill="%s" font-size="8" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="end">LIVER</text>
 <line x1="122" y1="185" x2="164" y2="178" stroke="%s" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3,2" opacity="0.6"/>
 <text x="166" y="176" fill="%s" font-size="8" font-family="monospace">ARTERY</text>
</svg>',
   ring(108,113,9,hc), ring(124,50,9,bc), ring(135,150,7,kc),

makeECGSvg <- function(prob) {
 amp <- round(prob * 55 + 12)
 sprintf('
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 60" width="100%%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none">
 <defs>
   <linearGradient id="ecgg" x1="0%%" y1="0%%" x2="100%%" y2="0%%">
     <stop offset="0%%" stop-color="#06d6a0" stop-opacity="0"/>
     <stop offset="30%%" stop-color="#06d6a0"/>
     <stop offset="70%%" stop-color="#ff4d6d"/>
     <stop offset="100%%" stop-color="#ff4d6d" stop-opacity="0"/>
   </linearGradient>
   <filter id="eg"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
 </defs>
 <path d="M0,30 L50,30 L68,30 L78,10 L88,%s L98,30 L115,30 L180,30 L198,30 L208,14 L218,%s L228,30 L245,30 L310,30 L328,30 L338,12 L348,%s L358,30 L375,30 L420,30"
       fill="none" stroke="url(#ecgg)" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" filter="url(#eg)"/>
 <text x="400" y="14" fill="#1e3347" font-size="9" font-family="monospace">LIVE</text>
 <circle cx="406" cy="20" r="4" fill="#ff4d6d" opacity="0.9">
   <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.9;0.2;0.9" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
 </circle>
</svg>',
   60-amp, 60-round(amp*0.85), 60-round(amp*0.7))
}
 
# ─── MASTER CSS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
APP_CSS <- '
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400;500;700&family=Epilogue:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap");
 
:root {
 /* Palette */
 --bg0:      #060d16;
 --bg1:      #0b1724;
 --bg2:      #0f1e2d;
 --bg3:      #142334;
 --bg4:      #1a2d40;
 --surface:  #1e3347;
 --accent:   #06d6a0;
 --accent2:  #0abde3;
 --danger:   #ff4d6d;
 --warn:     #ff9f1c;
 --success:  #06d6a0;
 --purple:   #9b5de5;
 --text:     #dce8f0;
 --text2:    #5a7d96;
 --text3:    #2e4a5f;
 --border:   #1a3347;
 --border2:  #1e3d55;
 /* Typography */
 --font:  "Epilogue", sans-serif;
 --mono:  "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
 --head:  "Syne", sans-serif;
 /* Tokens */
 --rad:   14px;
 --glow:  0 0 28px rgba(6,214,160,0.12);
 --glowd: 0 0 28px rgba(255,77,109,0.12);
 --gloww: 0 0 28px rgba(255,159,28,0.12);
}
 
/* ── Reset ── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
 
body, .container-fluid {
 background: var(--bg0) !important;
 color: var(--text) !important;
 font-family: var(--font) !important;
 margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important;
 min-height: 100vh;
}
 
/* ── Animated grid backdrop ── */
body::before {
 content: "";
 position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
 background-image:
   linear-gradient(rgba(6,214,160,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
   linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(6,214,160,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
 background-size: 52px 52px;
 mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 40%, black 40%, transparent 100%);
}
body::after {
 content: "";
 position: fixed; top: -30%; left: -10%;
 width: 55%; height: 70%;
 background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(6,214,160,0.035) 0%, transparent 68%);
 pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
}
 
.container-fluid, .tab-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
 
/* ── HEADER ── */
.cvd-header {
 display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
 padding: 16px 30px 14px;
 background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,214,160,0.06) 0%, transparent 100%);
 border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
 position: relative;
}
.cvd-header::after {
 content: "";
 position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 0;
 width: 220px; height: 1px;
 background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), transparent);
}
.cvd-logo {
 display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
 font-family: var(--head);
 font-size: 1.75em; font-weight: 800;
 letter-spacing: 0.08em;
 background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent2) 100%);
 -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
 background-clip: text;
}
.cvd-logo-mark {
 width: 40px; height: 40px;
 background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
 border-radius: 11px;
 display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
 font-size: 20px; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(6,214,160,0.35);
 -webkit-text-fill-color: initial;
}
.cvd-subtitle {
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.68em; color: var(--text2);
 letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-top: 3px; font-weight: 300;
}
.cvd-status {
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.73em; color: var(--text2);
 display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.status-pip {
 width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
 background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--success);
 animation: blink 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--success)} 50%{opacity:0.4;box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--success)} }
 
/* ── TABS ── */
.nav-tabs {
 border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 background: var(--bg1);
 padding: 0 24px;
 display: flex; gap: 0; overflow-x: auto;
 scrollbar-width: none;
}
.nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.nav-tabs .nav-link {
 color: var(--text2) !important; border: none !important;
 font-family: var(--mono) !important; font-size: 0.73em !important;
 letter-spacing: 0.07em; padding: 15px 20px !important;
 white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 0 !important;
 position: relative; transition: color 0.22s;
}
.nav-tabs .nav-link::after {
 content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; right: 50%;
 height: 2px; background: var(--accent);
 box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent);
 transition: left 0.22s, right 0.22s;
}
.nav-tabs .nav-link:hover { color: var(--text) !important; background: rgba(6,214,160,0.04) !important; }
.nav-tabs .nav-link.active { color: var(--accent) !important; background: transparent !important; }
.nav-tabs .nav-link.active::after { left: 0; right: 0; }
.tab-content { padding: 22px 28px; }
 
/* ── CARDS ── */
.card {
 background: var(--bg2) !important;
 border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 border-radius: var(--rad) !important;
 padding: 22px !important;
 margin-bottom: 18px;
 position: relative; overflow: hidden;
 transition: border-color 0.28s, box-shadow 0.28s;
}
.card::before {
 content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px;
 background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(6,214,160,0.35) 50%, transparent 100%);
 opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.28s;
}
.card:hover { border-color: var(--border2) !important; box-shadow: var(--glow) !important; }
.card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
 
/* Card title */
.ct {
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.7em; color: var(--text2);
 letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
 margin-bottom: 18px;
 display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
.ct::before {
 content: ""; display: block; width: 3px; height: 16px;
 background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
 border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent);
 flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ct-warn::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--warn), #ff6b00); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--warn); }
.ct-danger::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--danger), #c90032); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--danger); }
 
/* ── SECTION RULE ── */
.srule {
 display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 10px 0 16px;
 color: var(--text3); font-size: 0.67em; font-family: var(--mono);
 letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.srule::before, .srule::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border); }
 
/* ── KPI CARDS ── */
.kpi-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.kpi-card {
 flex: 1 1 130px;
 background: var(--bg3);
 border: 1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px;
 position: relative; overflow: hidden;
 cursor: default; transition: transform 0.22s, border-color 0.22s, box-shadow 0.22s;
}
.kpi-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--border2); }
.kpi-card::after {
 content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
 height: 2px; border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px;
}
.kpi-hi::after  { background: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--danger); }
.kpi-mid::after { background: var(--warn);   box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--warn); }
.kpi-lo::after  { background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--success); }
.kpi-label {
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.63em; color: var(--text2);
 letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.kpi-value { font-family: var(--head); font-size: 2em; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 5px; }
.kpi-badge {
 display: inline-block; font-family: var(--mono);
 font-size: 0.58em; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.badge-hi  { background: rgba(255,77,109,0.1);  color: var(--danger);  border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,109,0.22); }
.badge-mid { background: rgba(255,159,28,0.1);  color: var(--warn);    border: 1px solid rgba(255,159,28,0.22); }
.badge-lo  { background: rgba(6,214,160,0.1);   color: var(--success); border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,160,0.22); }
 
/* ── VITALS MINI GRID ── */
.vgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.vgrid-item {
 background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 11px; padding: 13px 14px; text-align: center;
 transition: border-color 0.22s;
}
.vgrid-item:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }
.vgrid-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.6em; color: var(--text3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.vgrid-value { font-family: var(--head); font-size: 1.55em; font-weight: 700; }
.vgrid-unit  { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.6em; color: var(--text3); margin-top: 2px; }
 
/* ── ECG BAR ── */
.ecg-bar {
 background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 16px;
 margin-bottom: 16px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.ecg-bar::before {
 content: "ECG MONITOR"; position: absolute;
 top: 8px; right: 14px;
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.6em; color: var(--text3); letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}
 
/* ── RISK BARS ── */
.rbar-wrap { margin-bottom: 13px; }
.rbar-lbl {
 display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.7em; color: var(--text2); margin-bottom: 5px;
}
.rbar-bg {
 height: 7px; background: var(--bg3);
 border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.rbar-fill {
 height: 100%; border-radius: 4px;
 transition: width 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1);
 position: relative;
}
.rbar-fill::after {
 content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0; inset-block: 0;
 width: 28px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.18));
}
 
/* ── ALERT BANNER ── */
.alert-strip {
 border-radius: 11px; padding: 13px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
 font-size: 0.84em; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start;
}
.alert-strip.hi  { background: rgba(255,77,109,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,77,109,0.22); color: #ffaab8; }
.alert-strip.mid { background: rgba(255,159,28,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,159,28,0.22); color: #ffd490; }
.alert-strip.lo  { background: rgba(6,214,160,0.07);  border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,160,0.22);  color: #9aecd8; }
.alert-icon { font-size: 1.15em; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
 
/* ── INPUTS ── */
.form-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
input[type="number"], input[type="text"], select, textarea, .form-control {
 background: var(--bg3) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 color: var(--text) !important; border-radius: 10px !important;
 font-family: var(--mono) !important; font-size: 0.83em !important;
 padding: 9px 14px !important; width: 100% !important;
 transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, background 0.2s;
 outline: none !important; -webkit-appearance: none;
}
input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus, .form-control:focus {
 border-color: var(--accent) !important;
 background: var(--bg4) !important;
 box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(6,214,160,0.1) !important;
}
label { color: var(--text2) !important; font-family: var(--mono) !important; font-size: 0.7em !important; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 5px; }
select option { background: var(--bg3); color: var(--text); }
 
/* ── BUTTONS ── */
.btn, button:not(.dt-button), .action-button {
 background: transparent !important;
 border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 color: var(--text) !important;
 border-radius: 10px !important;
 font-family: var(--mono) !important; font-size: 0.78em !important;
 padding: 9px 20px !important;
 cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.22s !important;
 letter-spacing: 0.04em; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.btn:hover, button:not(.dt-button):hover, .action-button:hover {
 border-color: var(--accent) !important; color: var(--accent) !important;
 box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(6,214,160,0.12) !important;
 transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}
.btn:active { transform: translateY(0) !important; }
 
.btn-primary {
 background: linear-gradient(130deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2)) !important;
 color: #04111e !important; border: none !important; font-weight: 600 !important;
 box-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(6,214,160,0.22) !important;
}
.btn-primary:hover {
 background: linear-gradient(130deg, #09f8bb, #0fd4f5) !important;
 color: #04111e !important;
 box-shadow: 0 6px 32px rgba(6,214,160,0.38) !important;
 transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}
.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg3) !important; border-color: var(--border2) !important; }
.btn-danger {
 background: linear-gradient(130deg, var(--danger), #c90032) !important;
 color: white !important; border: none !important;
 box-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(255,77,109,0.22) !important;
}
 
/* ── PRE / VERBATIM ── */
pre, .shiny-text-output {
 background: var(--bg3) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 color: var(--accent) !important; border-radius: 10px !important;
 padding: 16px !important; font-family: var(--mono) !important;
 font-size: 0.77em !important; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;
 line-height: 1.75;
}
 
/* ── CHATBOX ── */
#chatbox {
 background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 12px; height: 420px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 18px;
}
.chat-msg { margin-bottom: 16px; animation: fadeup 0.3s ease-out; }
@keyframes fadeup { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
.chat-msg .role {
 font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.62em; color: var(--text3);
 margin-bottom: 5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.chat-msg.user   .content {
 background: var(--bg4); border: 1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 12px 12px 4px 12px; padding: 10px 15px;
 font-size: 0.87em; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 88%; margin-left: auto;
}
.chat-msg.assistant .content {
 background: rgba(6,214,160,0.048); border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,160,0.16);
 border-radius: 4px 12px 12px 12px; padding: 10px 15px;
 color: #9ae8d6; font-size: 0.87em; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 88%;
}
.chat-input-row {
 display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px;
 background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; align-items: flex-end;
}
.chat-input-row textarea {
 flex: 1; background: transparent !important; border: none !important;
 padding: 2px 0 !important; resize: none; font-size: 0.86em !important;
}
.chat-input-row textarea:focus { box-shadow: none !important; }
 
/* ── STORY CARD ── */
.story-shell {
 background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(6,214,160,0.045), rgba(10,189,227,0.045));
 border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,160,0.14); border-radius: 14px;
 padding: 24px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.story-shell::before {
 content: "\201C"; position: absolute; top:-28px; left:14px;
 font-size:9em; color:rgba(6,214,160,0.055); font-family:Georgia,serif;
 line-height:1; pointer-events:none;
}
.story-text { white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:0.87em; line-height:1.9; color:var(--text2); }
 
/* ── DATATABLES ── */
.dataTables_wrapper { color: var(--text) !important; }
.dataTables_wrapper * { background: transparent !important; color: var(--text) !important; border-color: var(--border) !important; }
table.dataTable { background: var(--bg2) !important; border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; }
table.dataTable thead th {
 background: var(--bg3) !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 font-family: var(--mono) !important; font-size: 0.7em !important; color: var(--text2) !important;
 padding: 12px !important; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em;
}
table.dataTable tbody td {
 padding: 10px 12px !important; font-size: 0.82em !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
}
table.dataTable tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--bg3) !important; }
.dataTables_filter input, .dataTables_length select {
 background: var(--bg3) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
 color: var(--text) !important; border-radius: 8px !important;
 padding: 6px 10px !important; font-size: 0.8em !important;
}
.dataTables_info, .dataTables_paginate { font-size: 0.77em !important; }
.paginate_button { background: var(--bg3) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border) !important; border-radius: 6px !important; color: var(--text) !important; margin: 0 2px !important; }
.paginate_button.current { background: var(--accent) !important; color: #04111e !important; border-color: var(--accent) !important; }
 
/* ── LAYOUT HELPERS ── */
.panel-pair { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.panel-pair > .card { flex: 1 1 260px; }
.gauge-card, .bmap-card { min-height: 290px; }
 
/* ── MODEL COMPARISON TABLE ── */
.mct { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:0.8em; }
.mct thead th { background:var(--bg3) !important; padding:11px; color:var(--text2); text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font-size:0.85em; letter-spacing:0.07em; text-transform:uppercase; }
.mct tbody td { padding:11px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
.mct tbody tr:hover td { background:var(--bg3) !important; }
.mct-best { background:rgba(6,214,160,0.04) !important; }
 
/* ── METRICS PILL ── */
.mpill {
 display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
 background:var(--bg3); border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:20px; padding:5px 12px;
 font-family:var(--mono); font-size:0.7em; color:var(--text2);
 margin:3px; transition:all 0.2s; cursor:default;
}
.mpill:hover { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); }
.mpill-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; }
 
/* ── LOADING SCREEN ── */
#cvd-loading {
 position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--bg0); z-index: 9999;
 display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 22px;
 transition: opacity 0.5s;
}
.cvd-spinner {
 width: 52px; height: 52px;
 border: 2px solid var(--border);
 border-top-color: var(--accent);
 border-radius: 50%;
 animation: spin 0.75s linear infinite;
 box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(6,214,160,0.18);
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.cvd-loading-text { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.8em; color: var(--text2); letter-spacing: 0.12em; }
.cvd-loading-sub  { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.65em; color: var(--text3); letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
 
/* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; height: 5px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border2); border-radius: 4px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--accent); }
 
/* ── MISC ── */
hr { border: none !important; border-top: 1px solid var(--border) !important; margin: 18px 0; }
.shiny-notification { background: var(--bg3) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border) !important; color: var(--text) !important; border-radius: 10px !important; font-family: var(--mono) !important; }
.shiny-plot-output { border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.radio label { color: var(--text2) !important; font-size: 0.82em !important; }
.radio input[type="radio"] { accent-color: var(--accent); }
.fade-in { animation: fadein 0.4s ease-out; }
@keyframes fadein { from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1} }
.slide-up { animation: slideup 0.38s ease-out; }
@keyframes slideup { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
 
/* ── REPORT LAYOUT ── */
.report-header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:22px; }
.report-score { font-family:var(--head); font-size:3em; font-weight:800; line-height:1; }
.report-meta  { font-family:var(--mono); font-size:0.7em; color:var(--text2); margin-top:5px; line-height:1.8; }
 
/* ── QUICK PROMPT BUTTONS ── */
.qpbtn {
 display:block; width:100%; text-align:left;
 font-family:var(--mono) !important; font-size:0.73em !important;
 padding:9px 14px !important;
 background:var(--bg3) !important; border-color:var(--border) !important;
 border-radius:9px !important; margin-bottom:6px !important;
 color:var(--text2) !important; transition:all 0.2s !important;
}
.qpbtn:hover {
 background:var(--bg4) !important; border-color:var(--accent) !important;
 color:var(--accent) !important; transform:none !important;
}
 
/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:768px){
 .cvd-header{padding:12px 16px;}
 .tab-content{padding:14px 16px;}
 .kpi-card{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 6px);}
 .panel-pair>.card{flex:1 1 100%;}
 .vgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
}
'
 
# ─── JS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
APP_JS <- '
// Voice recognition
var recognition = null;
function initVoice(){
 if(!recognition){
   var SRec = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
   if(SRec){
     recognition = new SRec();
     recognition.continuous = false; recognition.lang = "en-US"; recognition.interimResults = false;
     recognition.onresult = function(e){ Shiny.setInputValue("voice_text", e.results[0][0].transcript, {priority:"event"}); };
     recognition.onerror  = function(e){ console.warn("Voice error:", e.error); };
   }
 }
}
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("startVoice", function(m){ initVoice(); if(recognition) recognition.start(); });
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("stopVoice",  function(m){ if(recognition) recognition.stop(); });
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("speakText",  function(m){
 if("speechSynthesis" in window){ speechSynthesis.cancel(); speechSynthesis.speak(new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(m)); }
});
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("printPage", function(m){ window.print(); });
 
// Auto-scroll chatbox
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("scrollChat", function(m){
 var cb = document.getElementById("chatbox");
 if(cb) cb.scrollTop = cb.scrollTop + 9999;
});
 
// Loading overlay
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
 setTimeout(function(){
   var overlay = document.getElementById("cvd-loading");
   if(overlay){ overlay.style.opacity="0"; setTimeout(function(){ overlay.style.display="none"; }, 520); }
 }, 1600);
});
'
 
# ─── UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ui <- tagList(
 tags$script(HTML(APP_JS)),
 fluidPage(
   useShinyjs(),
   tags$head(
     tags$style(HTML(APP_CSS)),
     tags$script(src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/chart.umd.js"),
     tags$meta(name="viewport", content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1")
   ),
 
   # Loading overlay
   div(id="cvd-loading",
     div(class="cvd-spinner"),
     div(class="cvd-loading-text", "INITIALISING"),
     div(class="cvd-loading-sub",  "CVD RISK INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM v3.0")
   ),
 
   # ── Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   div(class="cvd-header",
     div(class="cvd-logo",
       div(class="cvd-logo-mark", HTML("&#10084;")),
       div(
         div("CVD ANALYTICA"),
         div(class="cvd-subtitle", "CARDIOVASCULAR RISK INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM")
       )
     ),
     div(class="cvd-status",
       div(class="status-pip"),
       "SYSTEM ONLINE  |  AI READY"
     )
   ),
 
   tabsetPanel(id="main_tabs", type="tabs",
 
     # ── Tab 1: Patient & Predict ───────────────────────────────────────
     tabPanel("⬡ PATIENT",
       fluidRow(
         column(4,
           div(class="card",
             div(class="ct", "PATIENT INPUT"),
             textInput("name", "Patient Name", "Patient"),
             div(class="srule", "DEMOGRAPHICS"),
             fluidRow(
               column(6, numericInput("age",    "Age (yrs)",   50, 1, 120)),
               column(6, selectInput("gender",  "Sex", c("Female"=1,"Male"=2)))
             ),
             fluidRow(
               column(6, numericInput("height", "Height (cm)", 170, 100, 220)),
               column(6, numericInput("weight", "Weight (kg)",  70,  30, 200))
             ),
             div(class="srule", "BLOOD PRESSURE"),
             fluidRow(
               column(6, numericInput("ap_hi", "Systolic",  120, 60, 250)),
               column(6, numericInput("ap_lo", "Diastolic",  80, 40, 150))
             ),
             div(class="srule", "BIOMARKERS"),
             selectInput("cholesterol","Cholesterol",
               c("Normal (<200 mg/dL)"=1,"Above Normal (200–239)"=2,"High (≥240 mg/dL)"=3)),
             selectInput("gluc","Blood Glucose",
               c("Normal (<100 mg/dL)"=1,"Pre-diabetic (100–125)"=2,"Diabetic (≥126)"=3)),
             div(class="srule", "LIFESTYLE"),
             fluidRow(
               column(4, selectInput("smoke",  "Smoking",  c("No"=0,"Yes"=1))),
               column(4, selectInput("alco",   "Alcohol",  c("No"=0,"Yes"=1))),
               column(4, selectInput("active", "Exercise", c("No"=0,"Yes"=1)))
             ),
             div(class="srule", "UPLOAD DATASET"),
             fileInput("file", "Upload .CSV dataset", accept=".csv"),
             actionButton("predict", "⬡  RUN ANALYSIS",
               class="btn-primary",
               style="width:100%;margin-top:10px;padding:13px !important;font-size:0.85em !important;")
           )
         ),
         column(8,
           uiOutput("vitals_grid"),
           uiOutput("kpi_row"),
           div(class="ecg-bar", uiOutput("ecg_svg")),
           div(class="panel-pair",
             div(class="card gauge-card",
               div(class="ct","RISK GAUGE"),
               uiOutput("gauge_svg"),
               uiOutput("framingham_ui")
             ),
             div(class="card bmap-card",
               div(class="ct","ORGAN RISK MAP"),
               uiOutput("body_map_svg"),
               div(style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;",
                 tags$span(class="mpill", div(class="mpill-dot",style="background:var(--danger)"), "High"),
                 tags$span(class="mpill", div(class="mpill-dot",style="background:var(--warn)"),   "Moderate"),
                 tags$span(class="mpill", div(class="mpill-dot",style="background:var(--success)"),"Low")
               )
             )
           ),
           uiOutput("risk_alert"),
           div(class="card",
             div(class="ct","RISK FACTOR BREAKDOWN"),
             uiOutput("risk_bars")
           )
         )
       )
     ),
 
     # ── Tab 2: Dataset ───────────────────────────────────────────────
     tabPanel("⬡ DATASET",
       div(class="card",
         div(class="ct","DATASET EXPLORER"),
         uiOutput("dataset_kpis"),
         hr(),
         DTOutput("dataTable")
       )
     ),
 
     # ── Tab 3: Models ────────────────────────────────────────────────
     tabPanel("⬡ MODELS",
       tabsetPanel(type="tabs",
         tabPanel("Logistic Regression",
           div(class="card",
             div(class="ct","LOGISTIC REGRESSION"),
             fluidRow(
               column(6, div(class="ct","MODEL SUMMARY"), verbatimTextOutput("logreg_summary")),
               column(6, div(class="ct","CONFUSION MATRIX"), verbatimTextOutput("logreg_metrics"))
             ),
             hr(), plotOutput("logreg_roc", height="290px")
           )
         ),
         tabPanel("Random Forest",
           div(class="card",
             div(class="ct","RANDOM FOREST"),
             fluidRow(
               column(6, div(class="ct","MODEL OUTPUT"), verbatimTextOutput("rf_summary")),
               column(6, div(class="ct","CONFUSION MATRIX"), verbatimTextOutput("rf_metrics"))
             ),
             hr(), plotOutput("rf_roc", height="290px")
           )
         ),
         tabPanel("XGBoost",
           div(class="card",
             div(class="ct","XGBOOST"),
             fluidRow(
               column(6, div(class="ct","MODEL OUTPUT"), verbatimTextOutput("xgb_summary")),
               column(6, div(class="ct","CONFUSION MATRIX"), verbatimTextOutput("xgb_metrics"))
             ),
             hr(), plotOutput("xgb_roc", height="290px")
           )
         ),
         tabPanel("AUC Comparison",
           div(class="card",
             div(class="ct","MODEL PERFORMANCE — AUC COMPARISON"),
             tags$canvas(id="aucChart", style="width:100%;height:310px;"),
             hr(),
             uiOutput("auc_table"),
             tags$script(HTML('
               Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("drawAUC", function(d){
                 if(window._aucChart) window._aucChart.destroy();
                 var ctx = document.getElementById("aucChart");
                 window._aucChart = new Chart(ctx, {
                   type:"bar",
                   data:{
                     labels: d.labels,
                     datasets:[{
                       label:"AUC Score", data: d.values,
                       backgroundColor: d.values.map(function(v){
                         return v>=0.8?"rgba(6,214,160,0.25)":v>=0.7?"rgba(255,159,28,0.25)":"rgba(255,77,109,0.25)";
                       }),
                       borderColor: d.values.map(function(v){
                         return v>=0.8?"#06d6a0":v>=0.7?"#ff9f1c":"#ff4d6d";
                       }),
                       borderWidth:2, borderRadius:10
                     }]
                   },
                   options:{
                     responsive:true, maintainAspectRatio:false,
                     animation:{duration:1800, easing:"easeOutElastic"},
                     plugins:{
                       legend:{display:false},
                       tooltip:{backgroundColor:"#0f1e2d",borderColor:"#1a3347",borderWidth:1,
                                titleColor:"#dce8f0",bodyColor:"#5a7d96",padding:14,
                                callbacks:{label:function(c){return " AUC: "+c.raw.toFixed(4);}}}
                     },

                     }
                   }
                 });
               });
             '))

# ─── SERVER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
server <- function(input, output, session) {
 
 # ── Reactive state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 rv_data      <- reactive({
   req(input$file)
   df <- read.csv(input$file$datapath, sep=";")
   df$age    <- round(df$age / 365)
   df$cardio <- as.factor(df$cardio)
   df
 })
 rv_logreg   <- reactiveVal(); rv_rf   <- reactiveVal(); rv_xgb   <- reactiveVal()
 rv_lg_sum   <- reactiveVal(); rv_lg_met <- reactiveVal()
 rv_rf_sum   <- reactiveVal(); rv_rf_met <- reactiveVal()
 rv_xg_sum   <- reactiveVal(); rv_xg_met <- reactiveVal()
 roc_rv      <- reactiveValues(lr=NULL, rf=NULL, xgb=NULL)
 rv_prob     <- reactiveVal(0)
 rv_ht       <- reactiveVal("—"); rv_db <- reactiveVal("—")
 rv_risk_str <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 rv_rec      <- reactiveValues(text=NULL)
 rv_ep       <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 rv_story    <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 rv_meals    <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 rv_ex       <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 rv_meds     <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 chat_df     <- reactiveVal(data.frame(
   role=character(), message=character(),
   sent_score=double(), sent_label=character(),
   stringsAsFactors=FALSE
 ))
 
 # ── Train models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 observeEvent(input$file, {
   req(rv_data())
   showNotification("Training models… this may take a moment.", duration=NULL, id="train_n", type="message")
   df <- rv_data(); set.seed(42)
   idx  <- createDataPartition(df$cardio, p=.8, list=FALSE)
   tr <- df[idx,]; te <- df[-idx,]
   feats <- c("age","gender","height","weight","ap_hi","ap_lo","cholesterol","gluc","smoke","alco","active")
 
   # Logistic regression
   lr <- glm(cardio~., data=tr[,c(feats,"cardio")], family=binomial)
   rv_logreg(lr); rv_lg_sum(capture.output(summary(lr)))
   p_lr <- predict(lr, te, type="response"); pr_lr <- ifelse(p_lr>.5,1,0)
   cm_lr <- confusionMatrix(factor(pr_lr), factor(te$cardio))
   rv_lg_met(capture.output(cm_lr))
   roc_rv$lr <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(te$cardio)), p_lr)
 
   # Random Forest
   rf <- randomForest(as.factor(cardio)~., data=tr, ntree=100, importance=TRUE)
   rv_rf(rf); rv_rf_sum(capture.output(print(rf)))
   p_rf  <- predict(rf, te, type="prob")[,2]; pr_rf <- predict(rf, te)
   cm_rf <- confusionMatrix(pr_rf, te$cardio)
   rv_rf_met(capture.output(cm_rf))
   roc_rv$rf <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(te$cardio)), p_rf)
 
   # XGBoost
   mkDM <- function(d) xgb.DMatrix(data=as.matrix(d[,feats]), label=as.numeric(as.character(d$cardio)))
   xgb  <- xgb.train(list(objective="binary:logistic",eval_metric="logloss",max_depth=4,eta=.08,subsample=0.8),
                     data=mkDM(tr), nrounds=60, verbose=0)
   rv_xgb(xgb); rv_xg_sum(capture.output(print(xgb)))
   p_xgb  <- predict(xgb, mkDM(te)); pr_xgb <- ifelse(p_xgb>.5,1,0)
   cm_xgb <- confusionMatrix(factor(pr_xgb), te$cardio)
   rv_xg_met(capture.output(cm_xgb))
   roc_rv$xgb <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(te$cardio)), p_xgb)
 
   session$sendCustomMessage("drawAUC", list(
     labels = c("Logistic Regression","Random Forest","XGBoost"),
     values = c(round(auc(roc_rv$lr),4), round(auc(roc_rv$rf),4), round(auc(roc_rv$xgb),4))
   ))
   removeNotification("train_n")
   showNotification("Models trained successfully!", duration=3, type="message")
 })
 
 output$dataTable <- renderDT({
   req(input$file)
   datatable(rv_data(), options=list(pageLength=10,scrollX=TRUE), class="display compact")
 })
 
 output$dataset_kpis <- renderUI({
   req(input$file); df <- rv_data()
   n <- nrow(df); pct <- round(mean(df$cardio==1)*100,1)
   div(class="kpi-row",
     div(class="kpi-card kpi-lo",
       div(class="kpi-label","RECORDS"),
       div(class="kpi-value",style="color:var(--success)",format(n,big.mark=",")),
       div(class="kpi-badge badge-lo","LOADED")),
     div(class="kpi-card kpi-hi",
       div(class="kpi-label","CVD POSITIVE"),
       div(class="kpi-value",style="color:var(--danger)",paste0(pct,"%")),
       div(class="kpi-badge badge-hi","CASES")),
     div(class="kpi-card kpi-lo",
       div(class="kpi-label","FEATURES"),
       div(class="kpi-value",style="color:var(--accent)","11"),
       div(class="kpi-badge badge-lo","VARS")),
     div(class="kpi-card kpi-mid",
       div(class="kpi-label","MEAN AGE"),
       div(class="kpi-value",style="color:var(--warn)",round(mean(df$age),1)),
       div(class="kpi-badge badge-mid","YRS"))
   )
 })
 
 # ── Prediction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 observeEvent(input$predict, {
   nd <- data.frame(
     age=input$age, gender=as.numeric(input$gender),
     height=input$height, weight=input$weight,
     ap_hi=input$ap_hi, ap_lo=input$ap_lo,
     cholesterol=as.numeric(input$cholesterol),
     gluc=as.numeric(input$gluc), smoke=as.numeric(input$smoke),
     alco=as.numeric(input$alco), active=as.numeric(input$active)
   )
   prob <- if (!is.null(rv_logreg())) {
     predict(rv_logreg(), nd, type="response")
   } else {
     s <- 0
     if(nd$ap_hi>140) s <- s+0.22
     if(nd$cholesterol>1) s <- s+(nd$cholesterol-1)*0.14
     if(nd$age>50) s <- s+(nd$age-50)*0.009
     if(nd$smoke==1) s <- s+0.14
     if(nd$gluc>1) s <- s+0.12
     if(nd$active==0) s <- s+0.08
     pmin(s, 0.97)
   }
   ht <- predictHypertension(nd); db <- predictDiabetes(nd)
   rv_prob(prob); rv_ht(ht); rv_db(db)
   rv_risk_str(paste0(
     "Patient: ",input$name,", Age: ",input$age,
     ", CVD Probability: ",round(prob*100,1),"%, ",
     "Hypertension: ",ht,", Diabetes Risk: ",db,
     ", BMI: ",calcBMI(input$weight,input$height),
     ", Systolic BP: ",input$ap_hi,", Diastolic BP: ",input$ap_lo,
     ", Cholesterol: ",c("Normal","Elevated","High")[as.numeric(input$cholesterol)],
     ", Glucose: ",c("Normal","Pre-diabetic","Diabetic")[as.numeric(input$gluc)],
     ", Smoker: ",ifelse(input$smoke==1,"Yes","No"),
     ", Alcohol: ",ifelse(input$alco==1,"Yes","No"),
     ", Physically Active: ",ifelse(input$active==1,"Yes","No")
   ))
 })
 
 # ── Vitals grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$vitals_grid <- renderUI({
   bmi  <- calcBMI(input$weight, input$height)
   bmi_c <- bmiColor(bmi)
   bp_c  <- if(input$ap_hi>140)"var(--danger)" else if(input$ap_hi>130)"var(--warn)" else "var(--success)"
   vi <- function(lbl, val, unit, col)
     div(class="vgrid-item",
       div(class="vgrid-label", lbl),
       div(class="vgrid-value", style=paste0("color:",col), val),
       div(class="vgrid-unit", unit))
   div(class="vgrid",
     vi("Systolic BP",  input$ap_hi, "mmHg", bp_c),
     vi("Diastolic BP", input$ap_lo, "mmHg", "var(--accent2)"),
     vi("BMI",         bmi, bmiCategory(bmi), bmi_c),
     vi("Age",         input$age, "years",     "var(--text)"),
     vi("Weight",      input$weight, "kg",     "var(--text)"),
     vi("Height",      input$height, "cm",     "var(--text)")
   )
 })
 
 # ── KPI row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$kpi_row <- renderUI({
   p <- rv_prob(); ht <- rv_ht(); db <- rv_db()
   bmi <- calcBMI(input$weight, input$height)
   mk <- function(lbl, val, cls, badge, col)
     div(class=paste0("kpi-card kpi-",cls),
       div(class="kpi-label", lbl),
       div(class="kpi-value", style=paste0("color:",col), val),
       div(class=paste0("kpi-badge badge-",cls), badge))
   div(class="kpi-row",
     mk("CVD RISK",     paste0(round(p*100),"%"), riskClass(p), riskLabel(p), riskColor(p)),
     mk("HYPERTENSION", ht, if(ht=="High")"hi" else "lo",
        if(ht=="High")"ALERT" else if(ht=="Low")"CLEAR" else "—",
        if(ht=="High")"var(--danger)" else "var(--success)"),
     mk("DIABETES RISK", db, if(db=="High")"hi" else "lo",
        if(db=="High")"ALERT" else if(db=="Low")"CLEAR" else "—",
        if(db=="High")"var(--warn)" else "var(--success)"),
     mk("BMI", bmi, if(bmi>30)"hi" else if(bmi>25)"mid" else "lo",
        bmiCategory(bmi), bmiColor(bmi))
   )
 })
 
 # ── ECG / Gauge / Body map ───────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$ecg_svg      <- renderUI({ HTML(makeECGSvg(rv_prob())) })
 output$gauge_svg    <- renderUI({ HTML(makeGaugeSVG(rv_prob())) })
 output$body_map_svg <- renderUI({
   HTML(makeBodyMapSVG(rv_prob(), rv_ht(), rv_db(),
                       as.numeric(input$smoke), as.numeric(input$active),
                       calcBMI(input$weight, input$height)))
 })
 
 # ── Framingham ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$framingham_ui <- renderUI({
   fs <- calcFramingham(input$age, as.numeric(input$gender),
                        as.numeric(input$cholesterol), input$ap_hi, as.numeric(input$smoke))

   div(style="text-align:center;margin-top:10px;padding:11px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--border);",
     div(style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.62em;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:3px;","FRAMINGHAM 10-YR SCORE"),
     div(style=paste0("font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.9em;font-weight:800;color:",col), paste0(round(fs*100,1),"%"))
   )
 })
 
 # ── Risk alert ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$risk_alert <- renderUI({
   p <- rv_prob()
   if(p==0) return(NULL)
   cls <- riskClass(p)
   icon <- if(p>0.65)"⚠" else if(p>0.4)"◈" else "✓"
   msg  <- if(p>0.65)
     "<strong>High Cardiovascular Risk Detected.</strong> Your score indicates elevated risk. Please consult a healthcare professional promptly. See the AI Plans tab for personalised guidance."
   else if(p>0.4)
     "<strong>Moderate Risk Identified.</strong> Multiple modifiable risk factors found. Targeted lifestyle changes can meaningfully reduce your risk."
   else
     "<strong>Low Risk Profile.</strong> Your cardiovascular health appears well-managed. Continue your healthy habits and monitor annually."
   div(class=paste0("alert-strip ",cls), div(class="alert-icon",icon), div(HTML(msg)))
 })
 
 # ── Risk bars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$risk_bars <- renderUI({

     list("Age Factor",
          min(round(input$age/105*90),95),
          if(input$age>60)"#ff4d6d" else if(input$age>45)"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0",

     list("Body Weight",
          min(max(round((input$weight-40)/140*95),5),95),

          paste0(input$weight," kg")),
     list("Blood Glucose",
          switch(as.character(input$gluc),"1"=14,"2"=58,"3"=90,14),
          if(input$gluc==3)"#ff4d6d" else if(input$gluc==2)"#ff9f1c" else "#06d6a0",
          c("Normal","Pre-DM","Diabetic")[as.numeric(input$gluc)]),
     list("Inactivity",
          if(input$active==0)72 else 10,

     )

 # ── ROC plot factory ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 rocTheme <- function() {
   theme_minimal() + theme(
     plot.background  = element_rect(fill="#0b1724",color=NA),
     panel.background = element_rect(fill="#0b1724",color=NA),
     panel.grid.major = element_line(color="#111e2b",linewidth=0.5),
     panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
     text             = element_text(color="#5a7d96",family="mono"),
     axis.text        = element_text(color="#2e4a5f",size=9),
     plot.title       = element_text(color="#dce8f0",size=11,face="bold"),
     axis.title       = element_text(color="#5a7d96",size=9),
     plot.margin      = margin(14,14,14,14)
   )
 }
 plotROC <- function(roc_obj, col, lbl) {
   req(roc_obj)
   df <- data.frame(x=1-roc_obj$specificities, y=roc_obj$sensitivities)
   ggplot(df,aes(x,y)) +
     geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=0,ymax=y), fill=col, alpha=0.07) +
     geom_line(color=col, linewidth=1.5) +
     geom_abline(linetype="dashed",color="#1a3347",linewidth=0.8) +
     geom_point(data=df[seq(1,nrow(df),length.out=20),],
                aes(x,y), color=col, size=1.6, alpha=0.7) +
     labs(title=paste0(lbl,"  |  AUC = ",round(auc(roc_obj),4)),
          x="1 – Specificity (FPR)", y="Sensitivity (TPR)") +
     rocTheme()
 }
 output$logreg_roc <- renderPlot({ plotROC(roc_rv$lr, "#06d6a0","Logistic Regression") }, bg="#0b1724")
 output$rf_roc     <- renderPlot({ plotROC(roc_rv$rf, "#ff9f1c","Random Forest") },       bg="#0b1724")
 output$xgb_roc    <- renderPlot({ plotROC(roc_rv$xgb,"#ff4d6d","XGBoost") },             bg="#0b1724")
 
 # ── AUC comparison table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 output$auc_table <- renderUI({
   req(roc_rv$lr)
   vals <- c(round(auc(roc_rv$lr),4), round(auc(roc_rv$rf),4), round(auc(roc_rv$xgb),4))
   nms  <- c("Logistic Regression","Random Forest","XGBoost")
   cols <- c("#06d6a0","#ff9f1c","#ff4d6d")
   best <- which.max(vals)
   tags$table(class="mct",
     tags$thead(tags$tr(
       tags$th("MODEL"), tags$th("AUC SCORE"), tags$th("BAR"), tags$th("STATUS")
     )),
     tags$tbody(lapply(seq_along(vals), function(i)
       tags$tr(class=if(i==best)"mct-best" else "",
         tags$td(if(i==best) tags$strong(style=paste0("color:",cols[i]),nms[i]) else nms[i]),
         tags$td(style=paste0("color:",cols[i],";font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono);"), vals[i]),
         tags$td(div(style=paste0("height:4px;width:",round(vals[i]*100),"px;background:",cols[i],";border-radius:2px;max-width:100%;"))),

 # ── Chat ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 doChat <- function(msg) {
   df  <- chat_df()
   ctx <- if(!is.null(rv_risk_str()))
     paste0("You are an empathetic cardiovascular health assistant. Patient context: ",
            rv_risk_str(), "\nProvide accurate, supportive, actionable guidance. Be concise but thorough.\n\n")
   else "You are a helpful cardiovascular health assistant. Give accurate, empathetic guidance.\n\n"
   prompt <- paste0(ctx, paste0(df$role,": ",df$message,collapse="\n"), "\nUser: ", msg)
   u_s  <- mean(sentiment(msg)$sentiment)
   u_lbl <- if(u_s>.05)"Positive" else if(u_s<-.05)"Negative" else "Neutral"
   df <- rbind(df, data.frame(role="user",message=msg,
                              sent_score=round(u_s,3),sent_label=u_lbl,stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
   chat_df(df)
   bot <- generateContent(prompt, CHATBOT_API_KEY)
   btxt <- if(bot$ok) bot$text else paste0("[Error] ",bot$text)
   b_s  <- mean(sentiment(btxt)$sentiment)
   b_lbl <- if(b_s>.05)"Positive" else if(b_s<-.05)"Negative" else "Neutral"
   df <- rbind(df, data.frame(role="assistant",message=btxt,
                              sent_score=round(b_s,3),sent_label=b_lbl,stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
   chat_df(df)
   updateTextAreaInput(session,"chat_input",value="")
   if(isTRUE(as.logical(input$tts))) session$sendCustomMessage("speakText",btxt)
   session$sendCustomMessage("scrollChat",list())
 }
 
 observeEvent(input$send_chat,  { req(nchar(trimws(input$chat_input))>0); doChat(input$chat_input) })

 # ── Recommendations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 observeEvent(input$gen_rec, {
   req(rv_risk_str())
   showNotification("Generating recommendations…", duration=NULL, id="rec_n")
   res <- genRecommendations(rv_risk_str(), CHATBOT_API_KEY)
   removeNotification("rec_n")
   txt <- if(res$ok) res$text else paste0("[Error] ",res$text)
   rv_rec$text <- txt
   output$rec_display <- renderUI({
     div(class="fade-in",
       div(style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.8em;line-height:1.85;
                  color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);
                  border-radius:10px;padding:20px;", txt))
   })
   # Emotion analysis
   ae <- generateContent(paste0(
     "Analyze the emotional tone of this health text. Provide concise bullet-point analysis of: ",
     "positivity, empathy, motivation, clarity, urgency.\n\n",txt), CHATBOT_API_KEY)
   if(ae$ok) {
     nrc <- get_nrc_sentiment(txt)
     scores <- sapply(c("joy","sadness","anger","fear","trust","disgust","surprise","anticipation"),
                      function(e) sum(nrc[[e]]))
     rv_ep(list(para=ae$text, scores=scores))
   }
   updateTabsetPanel(session,"main_tabs",selected="⬡ SENTIMENT")
 })

 # ── Story ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 observeEvent(input$gen_story, {
   p   <- rv_prob()
   lvl <- if(p>.65)"High" else if(p>.4)"Moderate" else "Low"
   col <- if(lvl=="High")"var(--danger)" else if(lvl=="Moderate")"var(--warn)" else "var(--success)"
   fac <- c(
     if(input$ap_hi>140)"Elevated systolic blood pressure",
     if(input$age>50)paste0("Age ",input$age),
     if(input$weight>80)paste0("Weight ",input$weight,"kg"),
     if(input$gluc>1)c("Normal","Pre-diabetic","Diabetic")[as.numeric(input$gluc)]
                       ,
     if(input$smoke==1)"Active smoker",
     if(input$active==0)"Sedentary lifestyle"
   )
   if(length(fac)==0) fac <- "generally healthy profile"
   showNotification("Crafting your story…",duration=NULL,id="story_n")
   res <- genStory(lvl, fac, input$name, CHATBOT_API_KEY)
   removeNotification("story_n")
   rv_story(if(res$ok) res$text else paste0("[Error] ",res$text))
   pct <- if(lvl=="High")88 else if(lvl=="Moderate")54 else 18
   output$story_badge <- renderUI({
     div(class="slide-up",
       style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:18px;padding:20px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);",
       div(style=paste0("display:inline-block;width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;",
         "background:",col,"14;border:2px solid ",col,";",
         "line-height:110px;font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.1em;font-weight:700;color:",col),
         paste0(lvl," Risk")),
       div(style="width:65%;height:6px;background:var(--border);border-radius:3px;margin:14px auto 0;overflow:hidden;",
         div(style=paste0("width:",pct,"%;height:100%;background:",col,";border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 0 12px ",col)))
     )
   })
   output$story_body <- renderUI({
     div(class="fade-in story-text", rv_story())
   })
 })

       div(class="vgrid-item",div(class="vgrid-label","Active"),
           div(class="vgrid-value",style=if(input$active==1)"color:var(--success)" else "color:var(--warn)",if(input$active==1)"YES" else "NO"),div(class="vgrid-unit","status"))
     ),
     div(class="ct","RISK SUMMARY"),
     div(class=paste0("alert-strip ",riskClass(p)),
       div(class="alert-icon","⬡"),
       div(
         div(style=paste0("font-weight:700;color:",col,";margin-bottom:5px;font-size:1.05em;"),
             paste0("10-Year CVD Risk: ",round(p*100,1),"% — ",lbl)),
         div(style="font-size:0.85em;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.8;",
             paste0("Hypertension Risk: ",rv_ht()," | Diabetes Risk: ",rv_db()),tags$br(),
             paste0("BMI: ",bmi," (",bmiCategory(bmi),") | Framingham Score: ",round(fs*100,1),"%"))
       )
     )
   )
 })

 qs <- reactiveVal(NULL)
 observeEvent(input$main_tabs, {
   if(input$main_tabs=="⬡ FEEDBACK") {
     res <- generateContent(
       "Generate exactly 5 thoughtful open-ended questions to assess a patient's understanding and readiness to implement cardiovascular health recommendations. Number 1-5. Be empathetic and practical.",
       CHATBOT_API_KEY)
     if(res$ok) {
       ql <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(res$text,"\n+")))
       ql <- ql[nchar(ql)>5]
       qs(ql[1:min(5,length(ql))])
     } else {
       qs(c(
         "1. What was the most important insight you gained from your risk assessment today?",
         "2. Which recommendations do you feel most confident about implementing first?",
         "3. What specific barriers might prevent you from following these recommendations?",
         "4. How do you plan to track and measure your cardiovascular health progress?",
         "5. What additional support or information do you need to make these changes?"
       ))
     }
   }
 })

     do.call(tagList, lapply(seq_along(qs()), function(i)
       div(style="margin-bottom:20px;",
         div(class="ct", qs()[[i]]),
         textAreaInput(paste0("q",i),NULL,value="",rows=3,
           placeholder="Your answer…", width="100%"))
     ))

 })
